t: Sleek, compact smart radiator thermostat offers energy savings as well as efficient heating. Features premium touch display for intuitive installation and operation. Uses Smart Schedules to keep rooms at the right temperature, recognising when windows are open without additional window sensors, and sending a reminder to turn down the heating. Checks local conditions to keep the heating level comfortable in any weather, and allows individual rooms to be heated as required. The app stores data on user's heating behaviour and energy savings, and also provides insights into air quality and how to improve it. Supplied with integrated rechargeable battery which can be charged using any USB-C cable (sold separately), avoiding the need to buy or dispose of batteries. Controllable from anywhere via the app, or by using voice commands. Can be connected to other Matter-compatible devices and brands. Requires Tado Bridge X or another Thread border router (both sold separately).
b: Works with - Matter - Amazon Alexa - Apple HomeKit - Google Home - iOS App - Android App
